content.short: Non-custodial smart vaults where human managers and AI agents run strategies within hard limits.
content.description: Rigoblock provides on-chain vaults for running trading and liquidity strategies without taking custody of depositors' funds. Built-in protections, called Swap Shield, NAV Shield and Scoped Delegation, cap what an operator or AI agent is allowed to do, and a harness lets agents trade safely within those bounds. Instead of management fees, operators earn GRG tokens through Proof of Performance.
